name: One-Time Pad
body:
Price 1,800 gp; Aura faint evocation; CL 9th; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This single use magic item is an enchanted blank sheet of vellum, separated into two parts. When a message is written on the sending sheet, it magically appears on the receiving sheet and the sending sheet is consumed in a brief heatless fire. There is no range limit on a one-time pad, however if the sheets are on different planes of existence there is a 5% chance of failure.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 900 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells sending
